title: Teeth Coming Through
desc: Your first teeth have started making their way through, and your little body is feeling every bit of it. You are doing your best, even on the hard days.
story: We could tell something was shifting before we even fully understood what it was. You were unsettled in a way that was not quite you, fussier than usual, rubbing your ears with those tiny hands like something deep inside was bothering you. Your fingers found their way into your mouth constantly, and when they were not enough, you searched for anything else that might bring a little relief. It was hard to watch you uncomfortable and not be able to do much more than hold you close and ride it out together. Those little teeth are fighting their way through, and as exhausting as these days have been, we know something new and wonderful is just beneath the surface.
